limits: Measurements apply only to the named source revisions and inputs. They do not qualify later merged source, packages or platforms.
Known report cases are not a held-out engine-wide corpus. Exact output preserves existing font/resource/layout/accessibility differences.
All slower and inconclusive observations remain in their own cohorts. Lower managed allocation does not override slower latency.
Normal development-host scheduling; no affinity, quiet-host, cold-start, peak/retained-memory, portable ranking or timing-variation cause claim.
Total managed allocation per operation is distinct from retained/peak memory. No measured outliers were removed.
